pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Symlinks tree-sitter parsers into /usr/share/nvim/site/parser so Neovim can load them. Exists because app-editors/neovim only symlinks the six parsers it DEPENDs on and omits markdown_inline, which upstream Neovim bundles: the block and inline markdown grammars come from a single tree-sitter-markdown tarball that Gentoo split into two packages. Without the inline parser no in-buffer markdown renderer works, and the failure is quiet because the markdown_inline queries ship in the runtime tree regardless.
This package should be retired once app-editors/neovim links the parser itself. Keep it to that omission plus html; it is not a general parser distribution.
